title: ProjectContribution
description: Universal project descriptor written by build-tool-specific KSs (MavenProjectKS, GradleProjectKS, future NpmScanKS / PoetryScanKS / etc.). Each producer KS projects its native descriptor (pom.xml, build.gradle, package.json, ...) into this common envelope IN-PROCESS before posting; the raw native form is NOT a blackboard slot. This mirrors the SCIP design (scip-java / scip-typescript / scip-python all emit the same SymbolInformation envelope). Consumers that only need universal fields (id, sourceRoots, dependencies, buildTool) read this slot uniformly. Tool-aware consumers may additionally inspect `nativeAttributes` (free-form escape hatch) and follow `nativeDescriptorPath` (back-pointer) to read the raw descriptor file from the working copy when fidelity is required.

id.description: Universal project identity. Producer KS chooses a stable, build-tool-namespaced form: 'maven:groupId:artifactId:version' for Maven; 'gradle:<projectPath>' (e.g. 'gradle::libs:core') for Gradle. Used as the contribution identityKey.

buildTool.description: Best-fit producer label (analogue of SCIP `SymbolInformation.kind`). Open enum — additional values may appear as new producer KSs are added.

displayName.description: Human-friendly name for diagnostics (e.g. 'com.example:foo', ':libs:core'). Not an identity field.

version.description: Project version when declared by the build tool. Optional (some Gradle subprojects inherit version).

sourceRoots.description: Repo-relative POSIX paths of source directories (main + test + tool-specific extras), normalized by the producer KS.

dependencies.description: Declared (build-time) dependencies projected to a universal coord/kind shape. Producer KS is responsible for projection; tool-specific scope/configuration is preserved as an opaque string in `kind`. For resolved/deployed truth use Repository.SbomComponent.

coord.description: Universal dependency coordinate string in tool-namespaced form: 'maven:groupId:artifactId:version', 'npm:@scope/name@version', 'pypi:name==version', 'cargo:name@version', 'project:<intra-build-id>' for intra-build references.

kind.description: Tool-native scope/configuration preserved verbatim (e.g. Maven 'compile'/'test'/'provided'; Gradle 'implementation'/'api'/'testImplementation'/'annotationProcessor'). Open string — consumers that care about scope must understand the producer's vocabulary.

nativeDescriptorPath.description: Repo-relative POSIX path to the raw native descriptor (pom.xml, build.gradle(.kts), package.json, pyproject.toml, ...). Back-pointer for tool-aware consumers that need to read the original file from the working copy.

nativeAttributes.description: Free-form escape hatch for tool-specific attributes that don't fit the universal envelope (analogue of SCIP `SymbolInformation.signature_documentation`). Tool-agnostic consumers ignore this field; tool-aware consumers MAY inspect it but MUST tolerate its absence. Examples: { packaging: 'war', parent: {...} } for Maven; { plugins: [...], settingsScriptPath: '...' } for Gradle.
